scene.description: A 1938 bungalow family room, 14 ft 5 in x 12 ft, viewed from the wide cased opening, looking toward a wall of gridless French doors with two sidelights, backyard patio visible through the glass.
scene.style: editorial interior photography, photorealistic, warm and realistic
scene.foreground_frame: the painted cased opening, hallway wood floor and stone tile threshold, and the white built-in cabinet at the right edge stay exactly as in the reference

camera.position: standing in the hallway just outside the wide cased opening, identical to the reference photo
camera.focal_length: match reference (approx. 26mm full-frame equivalent smartphone wide)
camera.crop: nothing cropped out; same field of view as the reference

lighting.exposure: balanced, natural dynamic range, no HDR glow, no blown-out windows

floor.plank_direction: running from the camera toward the French doors

tv_wall.location: left wall behind the TV and media console only

walls.location: all other walls inside the room

furniture.description: walnut mid-century media console with the wall-mounted TV above it on the left wall
walnut-arm lounge chair with grey cushions
furniture.position: left corner nearest the camera, angled toward the room, unchanged
near the French doors at the end of the media console, unchanged

furniture.description: dark wood chest used as a coffee table
large monstera plant in a pot
low-profile sofa in rust performance velvet, matte velvet with subtle nap, slim tapered arms, two seat cushions, three loose back cushions, exposed tapered walnut legs
furniture.position: right wall, under the high window, facing the TV wall

furniture.description: 8x10 ft hand-knotted wool Oushak-style rug, low pile, slightly plush
furniture.motifs: floral and geometric, slate blue, faded gold, soft grey
furniture.fringe: short fringe on the two short ends only
furniture.position: 10 ft side running parallel to the sofa wall; sofa front legs, lounge chair and sling chair all resting on it; chest centered on it

furniture.description: 20 in diameter white drum flush mount, 5 in tall, frosted diffuser, burnished gold interior visible at the lower edge
furniture.position: same ceiling location as the existing dome fixture

furniture.description: slim aged brass floor lamp with a linen drum shade

changes.action: replace the beige carpet with natural white oak hardwood, matte, planks running toward the French doors
replace the teal and green botanical wallpaper with the small-scale olive, ochre and clay block print on warm cream, 6 in repeat, matte
paint all other walls Accessible Beige #D1C7B7 and all trim Ivory White #F2EDE1
replace the gridded French doors and both sidelights with gridless full-glass French doors and sidelights in the same openings, white frames
replace the grey sofa with the 108 in rust velvet sofa under the high window on the right wall; remove the end tables
add the 8x10 light blue Oushak-style rug
replace the small dome fixture with the 20 in white drum flush mount, dimmed warm 3000K
add one slim brass floor lamp with a linen shade behind the sling chair

keep: room shape, wall positions, crown molding, ceiling and ceiling height
French door wall position and proportions, including the two sidelights and the door openings
camera position, focal length and angle exactly as in the reference
the cased opening, hallway floor and the white built-in at the right edge of the frame
walnut mid-century media console and wall-mounted TV on the left wall
walnut-arm lounge chair with grey cushions in the left corner, angled toward the room
wood sling chair near the French doors
wood chest coffee table in the center
backyard patio, brick, lawn and fence visible through the glass
